{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 15], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "上次一脚都把我隔夜饭提吐出来了"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "那我怎么没看到"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我又给吃回去了"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我要去宰了毒鸭"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "为克莱尔报仇"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 11], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我理解你失去知有的心情"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 11], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "但是GTI有自己的计划"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 13], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我们不能贸然行事打乱这一切"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 13], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "我会用自己的方式向毒鸭复仇"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 8], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "不需要你们任何人"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.9411764705882353, 1.0, 0.0]}}}, "range": [0, 6], "size": 5.0, "bold": false, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.00016}], "font": {"id": "7265595305163231781", "path": "C:/HarmonyOS_Sans_SC_Regular.ttf"}}], "text": "咋穿成这样呢"}
